assets.caption: V-49 Vent and D-49 Drain — Hydrostatic Test Vents & Drains, Socketweld Piping, NPS 3/4 Thru 1-1/2
assets.description: Engineering detail drawing showing V-49 Vent assembly (top) and D-49 Drain assembly (bottom) for socketweld piping. Vent components include NPS 3/4 Blind Flange, NPS 3/4 Socket Weld Flange, NPS 3/4 x 100(4) Nipple (Plain Both End), NPS 3/4 Tee or Line Size x NPS 3/4 Reducing Tee, and NPS 3/4 Tee. Drain components mirror the vent configuration. Line size range is NPS 3/4 Thru 1-1/2.
